findings.description: Code implements 500-row chunking with constant VIEW_WRITE_CHUNK_ROWS=500 (adapters.rs line 225), splitting large tabs into successive update_range calls, whereas the specification never mentions this chunking strategy — only requiring the outcome of a single batchUpdate with truncated tail. Test confirms boundary: 500 rows = 1 call, 501 rows = 2 calls. This is code-side surplus optimization (spec silent, not contradicted), not a correctness gap. Severity: LOW (outcome correct, tests pass).
